## **How to cite GLOSSA**

Thank you for using **GLOSSA**! If you are using GLOSSA in your research, please cite the following paper:

> Mestre-Tomás, J., Fuster-Alonso, A., Bellido, J. M., & Coll, M. (2025). GLOSSA: A user-friendly R Shiny application for Bayesian machine learning analysis of marine species distribution. *Methods in Ecology and Evolution*, 00, 1–13. https://doi.org/10.1111/2041-210x.70167

GLOSSA is built on the work of many researchers and developers. To acknowledge their work, we provide citation guidelines for key contributions and inspirational works.

See the full **citation guidelines** here:
<a href="https://imares-group.github.io/glossa/how_to_cite.html" target="_blank">[Citation guidelines]</a>.
